steps.name: environment
steps.description: Persist NODE_ENV=development and ensure npm global bin is on PATH for non-interactive shells; validate node and npm exist; create workspace directory and set ownership. Writes /etc/profile.d/node_env.sh so future shells inherit NODE_ENV and npm global bin.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-40856-40905/SimpleCalculatorApplication"
NPM_BIN_DIR=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || echo "/usr/local/bin")
sudo tee /etc/profile.d/node_env.sh >/dev/null <<PROFILE
export NODE_ENV=development
export PATH="${NPM_BIN_DIR}:/usr/bin:/bin:$PATH"
PROFILE
sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/node_env.sh
command -v node >/dev/null || { echo "node not found" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v npm >/dev/null || { echo "npm not found" >&2; exit 3; }
node --version >/tmp/node_version.txt 2>&1 || true
npm --version >/tmp/npm_version.txt 2>&1 || true
sudo mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE" && sudo chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "$WORKSPACE"
# quick non-interactive PATH validation
env -i PATH="${NPM_BIN_DIR}:/usr/bin:/bin" bash -lc 'command -v npm' >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "npm not in PATH for non-interactive shells" >/tmp/env_error.txt; exit 4; }
exit 0

steps.name: scaffold CRA project (non-interactive)
steps.description: If package.json is missing in the workspace, non-interactively scaffold a minimal Create React App (JavaScript) project in the workspace using preinstalled create-react-app if compatible, otherwise npx create-react-app@latest. If package.json exists and looks like a CRA project, skip scaffolding. If package.json exists but is not CRA, fail fast to avoid overwriting user projects.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-40856-40905/SimpleCalculatorApplication"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
LOG=/tmp/scaffold.log
# If package.json exists, verify it's CRA-like and exit if so; else fail to avoid overwrite
if [ -f package.json ]; then
  node -e "try{const f=require('fs');const j=JSON.parse(f.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));const ok=!!(j.scripts&&j.scripts.start&&(j.dependencies&&(j.dependencies.react||j.dependencies['react-dom']||j.dependencies['react-scripts']))); if(!ok){console.error('package.json exists but is not a CRA project'); process.exit(5);} process.exit(0);}catch(e){console.error('invalid package.json');process.exit(6);}"
  exit 0
fi
# choose preinstalled create-react-app when available and recent, else npx
USE_NPX=1
if command -v create-react-app >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  CRA_VER=$(create-react-app --version 2>/dev/null || true)
  # treat unknown version as available but still use npx to ensure latest if older than 5
  CRA_MAJOR=$(echo "$CRA_VER" | cut -d'.' -f1 || echo 0)
  if [ "$CRA_MAJOR" -ge 5 ]; then USE_NPX=0; fi
fi
if [ "$USE_NPX" -eq 1 ]; then
  npx --yes create-react-app@latest . --use-npm > "$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; exit 7; }
else
  create-react-app . --use-npm > "$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; exit 8; }
fi
# ensure minimal start/build scripts exist
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='package.json';let j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p));j.scripts=j.scripts||{};j.scripts.start=j.scripts.start||'react-scripts start';j.scripts.build=j.scripts.build||'react-scripts build';fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(j,null,2))"
exit 0

steps.name: install dependencies (idempotent)
steps.description: Install project dependencies in the workspace. Use npm ci when package-lock.json exists and node_modules is missing for reproducible installs; otherwise use npm install. Back up package.json before edits. Do not reinstall global tools. Ensure react and react-dom are present and that package.json has start/build/test scripts. Logs to /tmp/npm_install.log.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-40856-40905/SimpleCalculatorApplication"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
[ -f package.json ] || { echo 'package.json missing' >&2; exit 9; }
cp package.json package.json.bak 2>/dev/null || true
LOG=/tmp/npm_install.log
: > "$LOG"
# prefer npm ci when lockfile exists and node_modules absent
if [ -f package-lock.json ] && [ ! -d node_modules ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --prefer-offline > "$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; exit 10; }
else
  npm install --no-audit --prefer-offline > "$LOG" 2>&1 || { cat "$LOG" >&2; exit 11; }
fi
# ensure react/react-dom and scripts exist; if changed, run a single npm install
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));p.dependencies=p.dependencies||{};let changed=false; if(!p.dependencies.react){p.dependencies.react='^18.2.0';changed=true;} if(!p.dependencies['react-dom']){p.dependencies['react-dom']='^18.2.0';changed=true;} p.scripts=p.scripts||{}; if(!p.scripts.start){p.scripts.start='react-scripts start';changed=true;} if(!p.scripts.build){p.scripts.build='react-scripts build';changed=true;} if(!p.scripts.test){p.scripts.test='react-scripts test --watchAll=false';changed=true;} if(changed){fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));process.exit(0);} process.exit(1)" && npm install --no-audit --prefer-offline >> "$LOG" 2>&1 || true
# record react versions for diagnostics
node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json');console.log(JSON.stringify({react:(p.dependencies&&p.dependencies.react)||'',react_dom:(p.dependencies&&p.dependencies['react-dom'])||''}));}catch(e){}" > /tmp/react_versions.txt 2>&1 || true
exit 0

steps.name: validation build and run (smoke test)
steps.description: Build the app, start the CRA dev server (BROWSER=none HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=3000), probe readiness on http://127.0.0.1:3000/, capture logs/evidence to /tmp, and terminate the server cleanly. Depends on environment, scaffold, dependencies, and testing to ensure a complete setup.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-40856-40905/SimpleCalculatorApplication"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
[ -f package.json ] || { echo 'package.json missing' >&2; exit 14; }
npm run build > /tmp/build.log 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/build.log >&2; exit 15; }
export BROWSER=none HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=3000
LOG=/tmp/react_dev.log
# start dev server in its own process group so we can kill whole group
setsid bash -lc 'npm start' > "$LOG" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
DEV_PGID=$(ps -o pgid= $PID | tr -d ' ')
echo "$DEV_PGID" > /tmp/dev_pgid
# probe readiness
( RETRIES=60; SLEEP=1; i=0; while [ $i -lt $RETRIES ]; do if curl --silent --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:3000/ >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo ready > /tmp/dev_ready && break; fi; i=$((i+1)); sleep $SLEEP; done )
if [ -f /tmp/dev_ready ]; then echo "dev server responded" > /tmp/validation_evidence.txt; head -c200 "$LOG" >> /tmp/validation_evidence.txt || true; else echo "dev server did not respond within timeout" > /tmp/validation_evidence.txt; cat "$LOG" >> /tmp/validation_evidence.txt || true; fi
# terminate process group
if [ -n "$DEV_PGID" ]; then sudo kill -TERM -"$DEV_PGID" 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 2; sudo kill -KILL -"$DEV_PGID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
exit 0
